answer: Standing is a vault that only opens when the identity remembers: each epoch’s work must draw on knowledge from many epochs ago — a fact, a lesson, a connection made long ago — and a juniper only grows when it is planted in old soil, while a delta only forms when the old streams converge. A farm of a thousand fakes has no long memory: they were created yesterday, so they remember nothing from twenty epochs ago, and one epoch of work that draws on nothing old adds nothing.
